snippet.title: Arcadice - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
*Wishlist Now:* 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3644830/Arcadice/

Handcuffed to a deadly arcade machine, fight for your life in its top-down shooter. Load weapons by inserting dice into the machine. Six failures and the sentry gun fires.
